 Do not reply back to this e-mail!
Hello,
Thank you for submitting a document to the Chemical Safety Compliance Team.
Your product is a kit/set/pack. A Safety Data Sheet is required for each possible hazardous product from the kit/set/pack, as indicated below:
color acrylic paint;
Ceramic clay
● We already received a compliant documentation for "color acrylic paint"
● The document uploaded for "Ceramic clay" is incomplete, inaccurate or otherwise conflicting, and cannot be used for classification. Specifically:
→ The SDS does not match the ( branding/manufacturer/logo of the product ):
The manufacturer/brand/logo of the product on the SDS is "Eternity Commerce LTD" while the listing manufacturer/brand/logo of the product is "Roaxkois".
Until we receive the entire valid documentation, for all the possible hazardous products from the kit/set/pack, the hazard warnings for your products may not appear on the ASIN's product detail page and your products may be rejected by some fulfillment centers.
For guidance on Safety Data Sheet requirements, please refer to https://sellercentral.amazon.com/help/hub/reference/G5G6BBSA6FZQP9CP
Once you have corrected the problems listed above, please re-upload a valid document in Account Health Dashboard under "Regulatory Compliance" section. For any questions/appeals regarding these product/other products, please submit them ( for each ASIN separately ) in "Account Health Dashboard" under the relevant Appeal reason:
1. Go to the Account Health page and select the Regulatory Compliance tab
2. Choose next steps.
3. Click Submit button for the product you’re taking action on.
4. To upload the documentation, drag and drop files, or browse to select files.
5. Click Submit to send your submission for our review.
We appreciate your prompt cooperation.
Thank you,

subject: OPR 体验优化——无需再手动追踪货件  /  Improvement to Your OPR Experience — No More Manual Shipment Tracking
body_preview:
尊敬的 Crifeton 团队：
我们很高兴地通知您，OPR（Operational Performance Review运营表现评估）流程迎来一项优化，这将使开启 OPR 变得更加简单，并且您无需再手动追踪货件。
变更内容：亚马逊的系统现在会自动识别在您开启 OPR 之前发出的货件，并将其从 OPR 扫描评估范围中排除。这意味着您不再需要等待所有未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存全部到达亚马逊运营中心后，再开启 OPR。
这对您意味着什么?
  1.  准备就绪（从现在开始所有商品都将正确应用 Transparency 透明计划标签）即可开启 OPR，无需再等待在途未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签货件全部入仓后再开启。
  2.  无需再人工追踪未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签货件的入仓时间。
  3.  您的 OPR 绩效数据将更加准确，因为仅包含应用了 Transparency 透明计划标签的产品的扫描结果。
  4.  更快、更顺畅地让您的产品获得 Transparency 透明计划保护。
您需要做什么？ 您的操作流程无需任何更改。请在您确保未来发出的货件（包括此前已创建但尚未发出的货件）都会正确应用 Transparency 透明计划标签时，即可开启 OPR。
若您需要帮助：请联系您的 Transparency 透明计划经理或客户管理团队协助。
常见问题
Q1: OPR 扫描有哪些变化？
亚马逊推出了货件感知处理流程（Shipment-Aware Processing），这是一项自动化流程旨在让您的 OPR 开启变得更加简单。在过去您需要谨慎考虑开启 OPR 的时间，以避免（已在途的）未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存在亚马逊运营中心扫描时失败，从而影响您的运营表现评估的结果。而现在我们的系统会自动追踪您的货件日期，只扫描在您开启 OPR 之后发出的货件。任何在开启之前已经在途的库存都不会被扫描。
Q2: 我需要有哪些不同的操作？
您的操作流程无需更改。如果您能确保未来发出的货件（包括此前已创建但尚未发出的货件）都会正确应用 Transparency 透明计划标签时，那么就可以开启 OPR。您不再需要等待所有未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存全部被亚马逊运营中心接收后再开启 OPR，系统会自动处理这一切。
Q3: 我现有的未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存会导致扫码失败吗？
不会。任何在您开启 OPR 之前发出的货件都会被扫描系统自动跳过。只有在您 OPR 开启日期之后发出的货件才会进行运营表现评估。
Q4: 这会影响 OPR 通过（Graduation）的时间吗？
不会。此项变更旨在优化您的 OPR 体验，消除 OPR 开启前库存因缺失 Trans

Q2: 我需要有哪些不同的操作？

What's changing: Our system now automatically identifies shipments that were sent before you activated OPR and skips them from scanning. This means you no longer need to wait for all unlabeled inventory to arrive at fulfillment centers before turning on OPR.
What this means for you:
  1.  Turn on OPR whenever you are ready, no need to time it around in-transit shipments
  2.  No more manual spreadsheet tracking of shipment dates
  3.  Your OPR metrics will be more accurate, reflecting only shipments that contain labeled products
  4.  Faster, smoother path to Protection
What you need to do: Nothing changes in your process. Continue to activate OPR when you begin labeling all your products with Transparency codes and have shipped all unlabeled shipments.
Need help? If you need support, please contact your Account Manager or Account Management Team for assistance.
Frequently asked questions:
Q1: What is changing with OPR scanning?
We are introducing Shipment-Aware Processing, an automated improvement that makes OPR activation simpler for you. Previously, you needed to carefully time when to turn on OPR to avoid unlabeled inventory (already in transit) from failing scans at fulfillment centers. Now, our system automatically tracks your shipment dates and only scans shipments that were shipped after you activate OPR. Any inventory already in transit before activation will not be scanned.
Q2: What do I need to do differently?
Nothing changes in your process. Continue to turn on OPR when you begin labeling your products with Transparency codes. You no longer need to wait for all unlabeled inventory to arrive before activating OPR, the system handles this automatically.
Q3: Will my existing unlabeled shipments fail scans?
No. Any shipments that were shipped before you activated OPR will be automatically skipped by the scanning system. Only shipments shipped after your OPR activation date will be scanned.
Q4: Does this affect my OPR graduation timeline?
No. This change is designed to improve your OPR experience by removing false failures from pre-activation inventory. Your OPR graduation metrics will be more accurate because they will only reflect shipments that should contain labeled products.
Q5: Do I still need to track my shipments manually?
No. The system now automatically determines which shipments should be scanned based on when they were shipped relative to your OPR activation date. You no longer need to maintain spreadsheets or manually track shipment timing.
Q6: Is this available in all marketplaces?
Yes. Shipment-Aware Processing applies across all marketplaces where Transparency OPR is active.
Thank you for being a Transparency partner.
Best regards,
Transparency Team

-- Original Message --
Greetings from Fulfillment by Amazon,
I am an Amazon associate extending an invitation to you, on behalf of our research team for FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program US.
Our program research team has identified you as a Seller that is not currently enrolled to our program. You may or may not potentially sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) products at this time, however you may be a Seller who would like to grow their business by starting to sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) ASIN(s) through Fulfillment By Amazon. Enrollment into the FBA Dangerous Goods Hazmat program allows sellers to continue offering/selling ASIN(s) on Fulfillment by Amazon, that have been reviewed and classified as Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) and are approved for sale through FBA.
What are dangerous goods? Dangerous goods (also called hazardous materials, or hazmat) are substances or materials that may pose a risk to health, safety, property, or the environment while storing, handling, or transporting because they contain flammable, pressurized, corrosive, or otherwise harmful substances. This may include many consumer-grade products such as perfumes, beauty products, household cleaners, and spray paints.
For more information on dangerous goods, visit our help pages in Seller Central:
- FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/help.html?itemID=ZLZBQ7W6QZRKWWK
- Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program Terms and Conditions: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GYS2KBEE7MYVCGE3
- Dangerous Goods Identification Guide: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
- Examples of Amazon Products that may be regulated as dangerous goods: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200525640
- FBA Dangerous Goods Review Process: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201749580
You can use the look up ASIN tool at any time to check the classification status of your ASIN and whether you need to be in the FBA Dangerous Goods program to sell it. Enter your ASIN in the “Look up an ASIN” tool found by searching “Dangerous Goods” or “Hazmat” in Seller Central help, or you can access it here: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) FC’s are specifically designed to safely process and store DG Hazmat inventory. At this time, the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program is by invitation only to select participants in US. Storage is limited to FBA Seller’s enrolled to the DG Hazmat program, and that are actively utilizing their physical storage space. Utilization of a Seller’s allocated storage space is assessed regularly.
If you choose “Yes” to enroll to the program, your hazardous materials storage limit will be 10 Cubic Feet Flammable storage, and 05 Cubic Feet Aerosol storage.
Please respond by 2026-09-01 with a definitive 'YES' to accept IF you would like to enroll or 'No' if you wish to decline. Once we receive your decision to enroll, there will be no action required on your part until your enrollment to the program has been finalized. You will receive a confirmation email, when your Seller account has been enabled.
There is not an enrollment fee to join the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items that are classified and approved to be sold only through the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program require special handling and hazardous materials (hazmat) storage. Effective February 15, 2019, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) introduced separate monthly storage fees for Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program. This change will first be reflected in April 2019 charges for storage that occurs in March 2019. Monthly inventory storage fees for other products will not change. Fulfillment fees for items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program are in effect as of February 19, 2019.
For fee schedules, definitions, and examples for the 2019 selling fee changes, visit the pages below.
- 2019 US FBA inventory storage fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/7DQBYCMB6KE58SG
- 2019 US FBA fulfillment fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GABBX6GZPA8MSZGW
- Inventory storage fees: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200612770
- FBA fulfillment fees for Amazon.com orders: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201112670
Friendly Reminder: Only classified ASIN(s) s are permitted to continue movement throughout the Fulfillment by Amazon network. FBA Sellers are responsible to comply with all product compliance requirements, regardless if you are or are not enrolled into the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. When listing a product that is under classification review and/or is regulated as a dangerous good (also known as Hazmat), you must provide specific product information and compliance documentation (e.g., Safety data sheet) to Amazon. Amazon uses this information to properly categorize your product, helping us ensure the safety of our customers, compliance with all applicable regulations, and that inventory in Amazon fulfillment centers is safe for storage, handling, and transportation. ASIN(s) in Unable to Classify (UTC) status will not be available for sale, and you will not be able to ship more of it to Amazon fulfillment center until classified safely. Once an ASIN is classified, you can proceed however you see fit (e.g. Inbound, Transship, Removal Orders, Disposal etc). Failure to provide this information complete and correct, may result in delays in processing your deliveries, as well as the cancellation of customer deliveries by Amazons carrier partners.
What if my items are classified as dangerous goods when I'm not enrolled in the program? You will be automatically added to the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program application waitlist. Any Amazon fulfillment center inventory that becomes classified as dangerous goods will be automatically transferred to an Amazon dangerous goods-capable fulfillment center.
Note: Transfers can take up to 14 business days. Inventory will be in “Reserved” status while in transit. Your listing will be active and sellable when the inventory has been received in the new location. Once your existing fulfillment center inventory is depleted, you will not be able to ship additional dangerous goods until you're enrolled in the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program.
Thank you for selling with Amazon,
Mengying T.

Greetings from Fulfillment by Amazon,
I am an Amazon associate extending an invitation to you, on behalf of our research team for FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program US.
Our program research team has identified you as a Seller that is not currently enrolled to our program. You may or may not potentially sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) products at this time, however you may be a Seller who would like to grow their business by starting to sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) ASIN(s) through Fulfillment By Amazon. Enrollment into the FBA Dangerous Goods Hazmat program allows sellers to continue offering/selling ASIN(s) on Fulfillment by Amazon, that have been reviewed and classified as Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) and are approved for sale through FBA.
What are dangerous goods? Dangerous goods (also called hazardous materials, or hazmat) are substances or materials that may pose a risk to health, safety, property, or the environment while storing, handling, or transporting because they contain flammable, pressurized, corrosive, or otherwise harmful substances. This may include many consumer-grade products such as perfumes, beauty products, household cleaners, and spray paints.
For more information on dangerous goods, visit our help pages in Seller Central:
- FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/help.html?itemID=ZLZBQ7W6QZRKWWK
- Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program Terms and Conditions: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GYS2KBEE7MYVCGE3
- Dangerous Goods Identification Guide: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
- Examples of Amazon Products that may be regulated as dangerous goods: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200525640
- FBA Dangerous Goods Review Process: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201749580
You can use the look up ASIN tool at any time to check the classification status of your ASIN and whether you need to be in the FBA Dangerous Goods program to sell it. Enter your ASIN in the “Look up an ASIN” tool found by searching “Dangerous Goods” or “Hazmat” in Seller Central help, or you can access it here: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) FC’s are specifically designed to safely process and store DG Hazmat inventory. At this time, the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program is by invitation only to select participants in US. Storage is limited to FBA Seller’s enrolled to the DG Hazmat program, and that are actively utilizing their physical storage space. Utilization of a Seller’s allocated storage space is assessed regularly.
If you choose “Yes” to enroll to the program, your hazardous materials storage limit will be 10 Cubic Feet Flammable storage, and 05 Cubic Feet Aerosol storage.
Please respond by 2026-09-01 with a definitive 'YES' to accept IF you would like to enroll or 'No' if you wish to decline. Once we receive your decision to enroll, there will be no action required on your part until your enrollment to the program has been finalized. You will receive a confirmation email, when your Seller account has been enabled.
There is not an enrollment fee to join the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items that are classified and approved to be sold only through the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program require special handling and hazardous materials (hazmat) storage. Effective February 15, 2019, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) introduced separate monthly storage fees for Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program. This change will first be reflected in April 2019 charges for storage that occurs in March 2019. Monthly inventory storage fees for other products will not change. Fulfillment fees for items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program are in effect as of February 19, 2019.
For fee schedules, definitions, and examples for the 2019 selling fee changes, visit the pages below.
- 2019 US FBA inventory storage fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/7DQBYCMB6KE58SG
- 2019 US FBA fulfillment fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GABBX6GZPA8MSZGW
- Inventory storage fees: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200612770
- FBA fulfillment fees for Amazon.com orders: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201112670
Friendly Reminder: Only classified ASIN(s) s are permitted to continue movement throughout the Fulfillment by Amazon network. FBA Sellers are responsible to comply with all product compliance requirements, regardless if you are or are not enrolled into the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. When listing a product that is under classification review and/or is regulated as a dangerous good (also known as Hazmat), you must provide specific product information and compliance documentation (e.g., Safety data sheet) to Amazon. Amazon uses this information to properly categorize your product, helping us ensure the safety of our customers, compliance with all applicable regulations, and that inventory in Amazon fulfillment centers is safe for storage, handling, and transportation. ASIN(s) in Unable to Classify (UTC) status will not be available for sale, and you will not be able to ship more of it to Amazon fulfillment center until classified safely. Once an ASIN is classified, you can proceed however you see fit (e.g. Inbound, Transship, Removal Orders, Disposal etc). Failure to provide this information complete and correct, may result in delays in processing your deliveries, as well as the cancellation of customer deliveries by Amazons carrier partners.
What if my items are classified as dangerous goods when I'm not enrolled in the program? You will be automatically added to the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program application waitlist. Any Amazon fulfillment center inventory that becomes classified as dangerous goods will be automatically transferred to an Amazon dangerous goods-capable fulfillment center.
Note: Transfers can take up to 14 business days. Inventory will be in “Reserved” status while in transit. Your listing will be active and sellable when the inventory has been received in the new location. Once your existing fulfillment center inventory is depleted, you will not be able to ship additional dangerous goods until you're enrolled in the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program.
Thank you for selling with Amazon,
Mengying T.

 Hello,
 According to rules for online stores issued by the State Council of China (Decree No. 810) and China State Taxation Administration Public Notice [2025] No.15 ("PN15"), we provide information on China-based sellers to the Chinese tax authority on a quarterly basis.
 Some sellers identified potential data discrepancies with the first quarterly tax report covering October to December 2025.  Hello Weihai US,

 Why is this happening?

 How do I reactivate my listings?
 To provide the required compliance information, go to your Account Health page and locate the product compliance requests:
-
 If you have the required documentation, follow the instructions to submit your compliance documents. We will only reinstate products that fulfill the compliance requirements.
-
 If you believe your products are exempt from these requirements, submit documentation demonstrating why they are not subject to these compliance requirements.
 For step-by-step instructions, see our Submit compliance documents or appeal a documentation request help page.
 To avoid further impact to your account, close or delete any non-compliant listings that you do not intend to sell or appeal.
 What happens if I don't take these actions?
 If you don’t provide the required compliance information, the impacted ASINs will remain deactivated until the compliance requests are fulfilled by you or another selling partner listing the product.
 What happens to my FBA inventory for these products?
 You must remove these products from our fulfilment centers within 30 days of this notice. If not removed, we will dispose of the inventory at your expense as outlined in our Amazon Services Business Solutions Agreement. To learn how to remove inventory, see our Remove Inventory help page.

如果您要在亚马逊商城发布商品，则必须遵守与这些商品和商品信息相关的所有适用法律、法规、标准以及亚马逊的政策（包括本政策）。亚马逊要求您在【英国，德国，法国，意大利，西班牙，瑞典，波兰，荷兰，比利时】销售的所有【儿童玩具】需经过【亚马逊认可的第三方检测、检验和认证 (TIC) 服务提供商】完成检测验证并符合下列法规、标准和要求： _x000D_
_x000D_
【法规标准是什么？】_x000D_
儿童玩具：EN 71 (玩具安全 )_x000D_

_x000D_
【商品详情页面要求】_x000D_
1.商品信息：型号、部件编号或商品编号、制造商或品牌名称、强制性警告声明、制造商建议的最低使用年龄（以月为单位）或制造商最低年龄（以月为单位）。_x000D_
2.图片要求：型号、部件编号或商品编号、制造商、进口商或私有品牌商、分销商或授权代表的名称和地址 、商品标签、合规标志、商品说明书与手册、CE标志。 _x000D_
_x000D_
【如何完成合规?】
1.您必须与第三方检测、检验和认证服务提供商合作，对收到通知的所有 ASIN 进行商品检测或验证现有的检测文件。请按照以下步骤操作：
1) 前往【绩效】-【账户状况】-【政策合规性】，点击【食品和商品安全问题】。
2) 在【后续步骤】列下，针对需操作的商品点击【提交】-【验证您的商品】。
3) 从清单中选择第三方检测提供商（如需比价，可先查看【从多个提供商获取报价的说明】后再返回选择），点击继续。
4) 确认详细联系信息，点击【确认并继续】。
5) 复制生成的检测申请表编号，提供给所选提供商完成检测。
如果验证现有文件，您必须将由 ISO 17025 认证实验室在过去 12 个月内出具的检测报告提交至检测、检验和认证服务提供商。

为确保及时完成合规验证，请在截止日期之前完成TRF的创建，并确保TRF状态更新为【正在验证】或【已通过】_x000D_

 Hej Weihai EU!
 Vissa av dina produktposter har inaktiverats på grund av att det saknas obligatorisk överensstämmelse för dina produkter. Granska informationen och följande steg nedan. De berörda produktposterna visas i slutet av det här e-postmeddelandet.
 Varför händer det här?
 Vi vidtar den här åtgärden eftersom det saknas obligatorisk information om överensstämmelse för de här produkterna. Läs vår hjälpsida för Produktsäkerhet och -överensstämmelse för information om tillämpliga lagar, förordningar och Amazons policyer. Vi har använt oss av både automatiserade metoder och mänskliga expertgranskare för att identifiera problemet och fatta det här beslutet.
 Tabellen i slutet av detta e-postmeddelande innehåller produktspecifika krav för överensstämmelse.
 Hur återaktiverar jag mina produktposter?
 Om du vill tillhandahålla den begärda överensstämmelseinformationen går du till sidan Kontostatus och letar upp begäranden om produktöverensstämmelse:
-
 Om du har den obligatoriska dokumentationen ska du skicka in dina överensstämmelsedokument enligt instruktionerna. Vi återaktiverar endast produkter som uppfyller kraven på överensstämmelse.
-
 Om du tror att dina produkter är undantagna från dessa krav skickar du in dokumentation som visar varför de inte omfattas av dessa överensstämmelsekrav.
 Du hittar stegvisa instruktioner på vår hjälpsida om Skicka in intyg om överensstämmelse eller bestrid en dokumentbegäran .

Pour vendre des jouets pour enfants, vous devez répondre aux exigences répertoriées sur la page d'aide relative aux jouets pour enfants et travailler avec l'un de nos fournisseurs tiers partenaires de services de test, d'inspection et de certification (TIC) pour vérifier que votre produit est conforme à ces exigences.
Un jouet pour enfants est un produit destiné à être utilisé à des fins d’apprentissage ou de jeu par un enfant âgé au plus de 14 ans.
Les jouets sont considérés comme des « jouets pour enfants » sur la base des critères suivants :
Selon la classification par âge figurant sur l’emballage, le produit est destiné à être utilisé par un enfant âgé au plus de 14 ans.
Le produit est présenté dans son emballage, son présentoir, sa promotion ou sa publicité comme étant adapté à un enfant d’un âge maximal de 14 ans.
Les consommateurs reconnaissent généralement que le produit est destiné à être utilisé par un enfant d’un âge maximal de 14 ans.
Pour plus d’informations sur les exigences de conformité, sur la manière de travailler avec un fournisseur de services TIC et pour visionner notre vidéo sur les jouets pour enfants concernés par cette politique, rendez-vous sur la page d’aide relative aux jouets pour enfants .

 ¿A qué se debe esto?
 Tomamos esta medida porque a estos productos les falta información de cumplimiento normativo obligatoria. Para más información sobre las leyes, normativas y políticas de Amazon aplicables, consulta Cumplimiento y seguridad de los productos .

 Soumettre la documentation de sécurité des produits pour réactiver les mises en vente
 Bonjour Weihai EU,
 Certaines de vos mises en vente ont été désactivées, car vos produits ne respectaient pas des exigences de conformité obligatoires. Consultez les détails et les étapes suivantes ci-dessous. Les produits mis en vente concernés figurent à la fin de cet e-mail.
 Pourquoi cela se produit-il ?
 Nous prenons cette mesure, car ces produits ne présentent pas les informations de conformité obligatoires. Consultez notre page d’aide Sécurité et conformité des produits pour obtenir des informations sur les lois, réglementations et politiques Amazon applicables. Nous nous sommes appuyés sur une combinaison de moyens automatisés et de contrôles menés par des personnes expérimentées pour identifier ce problème et prendre cette décision.
 Le tableau situé à la fin de cet e-mail présente les exigences de conformité spécifiques aux produits.
 Comment réactiver mes produits mis en vente ?
 Pour fournir les informations de conformité requises, accédez à la page État du compte et localisez les demandes de conformité des produits :
-
 Si vous disposez des documents requis, suivez les instructions pour soumettre vos documents de conformité. Nous rétablirons uniquement les produits répondant aux exigences de conformité.
-
 Si vous pensez que vos produits sont exemptés de ces exigences, soumettez des pièces justificatives prouvant les raisons pour lesquelles ils ne sont pas soumis à ces exigences de conformité.
 Pour des instructions détaillées, consultez la page d’aide Soumettre des documents de conformité ou contester une demande de documents .
 Pour éviter toute perturbation supplémentaire de votre compte, clôturez ou supprimez tous les produits mis en vente non conformes que vous n’avez pas l’intention de vendre ou de contester.
 Que se passe-t-il si je ne prends pas ces mesures ?
 Si vous ne fournissez pas les informations de conformité requises, les ASIN concernés resteront désactivés jusqu’à ce que les demandes de conformité soient traitées par vous ou un autre partenaire de vente ayant mis en vente le produit.
 Que va-t-il advenir du stock Expédié par Amazon de ces produits ?

 Dzień dobry Weihai EU,
 niektóre z Twoich ofert zostały zdezaktywowane z powodu niespełnienia obowiązków dotyczących zgodności wystawianych przez Ciebie produktów z wymogami. Poniżej znajdziesz szczegółowe informacje oraz dalsze instrukcje. Oferty produktów, których dotyczy problem, wskazano na końcu niniejszej wiadomości e-mail.
 Dlaczego tak się stało?

body_full:
96
 Important updates to commercial liability insurance requirements — new category-based requirements and AIA mandate for China-based sellers effective November 2, 2026.
 Hello,
 Effective November 2, 2026, we’re updating our commercial liability insurance requirements to help protect Amazon’s customers as well as help you protect your business from financial loss in the event of a product-related incident.
 Our existing policy requires all sellers to obtain and maintain commercial liability insurance within 30 days if gross proceeds from Amazon.com sales exceed USD 10,000 in any month, with minimum coverage of USD 1 million per occurrence and in the aggregate. While these requirements remain, we are introducing two additional requirements.
 First, sellers with products listed in categories with enhanced safety listing requirements will now be required to maintain a commercial liability insurance policy that covers those products, with a minimum coverage of USD 1 million per occurrence and in aggregate, regardless of whether they meet the USD 10,000 gross proceeds in a month threshold. This change applies to both new and existing listings.
 Product categories with enhanced safety listing requirements include, but are not limited to, children’s products, cosmetic and ingestible products, and lithium battery products. For the full list of categories impacted by these changes, go to Product categories with enhanced safety listing requirements .
 Second, sellers based in Mainland China must now obtain their insurance through the Amazon Insurance Accelerator (AIA) program. AIA connects you with a network of pre-vetted insurers who understand Amazon's coverage requirements, making it easier to secure compliant coverage, avoid policy rejections, and ensure your claims are supported when they arise. Starting November 2, 2026, we will reject newly submitted insurance policies that are not obtained through AIA. If you have a valid third-party insurance policy that meets the coverage requirements and was submitted to Amazon before November 2, you can continue using it until it expires. After that policy expires, you will be required to obtain insurance through AIA.
 If we determine that you require new or updated commercial liability insurance based on the categories that you sell in, you’ll receive an email from us requesting that you provide proof of insurance within 45 days of that notification. The email will include resources for obtaining coverage and instructions for submitting your documentation.
 These changes will take effect starting November 2, 2026. If you don’t submit required proof of commercial liability insurance, your listings in categories with enhanced safety listing requirements may be deactivated until you provide compliant documentation. Your listings in other categories will not be impacted.
 The updated Commercial Liability Insurance requirements page reflects these changes. For more information, go to the ‘frequently asked questions’ section on the Business Insurance page.

 Bonjour Weihai EU,
 Certaines de vos mises en vente ont été désactivées, car vos produits ne respectaient pas des exigences de conformité obligatoires. Consultez les détails et les étapes suivantes ci-dessous. Les produits mis en vente concernés figurent à la fin de cet e-mail.
 Pourquoi cela se produit-il ?
 Nous prenons cette mesure, car ces produits ne présentent pas les informations de conformité obligatoires. Consultez notre page d’aide Sécurité et conformité des produits pour obtenir des informations sur les lois, réglementations et politiques Amazon applicables. Nous nous sommes appuyés sur une combinaison de moyens automatisés et de contrôles menés par des personnes expérimentées pour identifier ce problème et prendre cette décision.
 Le tableau situé à la fin de cet e-mail présente les exigences de conformité spécifiques aux produits.
 Comment réactiver mes produits mis en vente ?

 Certaines de vos mises en vente ont été désactivées, car vos produits ne respectaient pas des exigences de conformité obligatoires. Consultez les détails et les étapes suivantes ci-dessous. Les produits mis en vente concernés figurent à la fin de cet e-mail.

Consultez notre page d’aide Sécurité et conformité des produits pour obtenir des informations sur les lois, réglementations et politiques Amazon applicables. Nous nous sommes appuyés sur une combinaison de moyens automatisés et de contrôles menés par des personnes expérimentées pour identifier ce problème et prendre cette décision.

 En la tabla que aparece al final de este correo electrónico se proporcionan los requisitos de cumplimiento normativo específicos del producto.
 ¿Cómo puedo reactivar mis listings?
 Para proporcionar la información de cumplimiento normativo obligatoria, ve a la página Estado de la cuenta y localiza las solicitudes de cumplimiento normativo del producto:
-
 Si dispones de la documentación obligatoria, sigue las instrucciones para presentar los documentos de cumplimiento normativo. Sólo restableceremos los productos que cumplan los requisitos de cumplimiento normativo.
-
 Si crees que tus productos están exentos de estos requisitos, presenta documentación que demuestre por qué no están sujetos a estos requisitos de cumplimiento normativo.
 Para ver instrucciones paso a paso, consulta Enviar documentos de cumplimiento normativo o recurrir una solicitud de documentación .
 Para evitar que tu cuenta se vea más afectada, cierra o elimina cualquier listing que no cumpla los requisitos y que no tengas intención de vender o recurrir.
 ¿Qué ocurre si no tomo estas medidas?
 Si no proporcionas la información de cumplimiento obligatoria, los ASIN afectados permanecerán desactivados hasta que tú u otro colaborador comercial que publique el producto gestionéis las solicitudes de cumplimiento normativo.
 ¿Qué ocurre con el inventario de Logística de Amazon de estos productos?
 Tienes que retirar estos productos de nuestros centros logísticos en un plazo de 30 días a partir de la recepción de este aviso. Si no los retiras, pondremos el inventario a nuestra disposición, corriendo tú con los gastos, según lo estipulado en el Acuerdo de Amazon Services Business Solutions. Para más información sobre cómo retirar tu inventario, consulta Retirada de inventario .
 Estamos aquí para ayudarte.
 Para más información, mira el vídeo Introducción a la seguridad y cumplimiento normativo de Seller University.

 Wat gebeurt er met mijn FBA-voorraad voor deze producten?
 Je moet deze producten binnen 30 dagen na deze kennisgeving uit onze fulfillment centers verwijderen. Indien deze niet worden verwijderd, zullen wij de voorraad op jouw kosten verwijderen zoals beschreven in onze Amazon Services Business Solutions-overeenkomst.  Informacje na temat wymogów dotyczących zgodności dla poszczególnych produktów znajdziesz w tabeli na końcu tej wiadomości e-mail.
 Jak mogę ponownie aktywować oferty?
 Aby dostarczyć niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgodności z wymogami, przejdź do panelu Kondycja konta i znajdź żądania dotyczące zgodności produktu z wymogami:
-
 Jeśli dysponujesz wymaganymi dokumentami zgodności, postępuj zgodnie z instrukcjami, aby je przesłać. Przywrócimy jedynie produkty, które spełniają oczekiwania dotyczące zgodności z wymogami.
-
 Jeśli uważasz, że Twoje produkty są zwolnione z wymogów dotyczących zgodności, prześlij dokumentację wskazującą przyczynę, dla której nie podlegają one tym wymogom.
 Szczegółowe instrukcje znajdziesz na stronie Przesyłanie dokumentów dotyczących zgodności lub składanie odwołania .
 Aby uniknąć dalszych negatywnych konsekwencji wobec konta, zamknij lub usuń wszelkie niezgodne z wymogami oferty, w przypadku których nie zamierzasz kontynuować sprzedaży ani składać odwołania.
 Co się stanie, jeśli nie podejmę tych działań?
 W przypadku niedostarczenia obowiązkowych informacji dotyczących zgodności z wymogami produkty, których dotyczy problem, pozostaną nieaktywne, dopóki żądania dotyczące zgodności z wymogami nie zostaną spełnione przez Ciebie lub innego partnera sprzedaży wystawiającego dany produkt.
 Co się stanie z zapasami FBA tych produktów?
 Musisz wycofać zapasy tych produktów z centrów logistycznych w ciągu 30 dni od tego powiadomienia. Jeśli ich nie wycofasz, usuniemy je na Twój koszt zgodnie z postanowieniami Umowy Amazon Services Business Solutions. Informacje na temat sposobu wycofywania zapasów znajdziesz na stronie Wycofywanie zapasów .
 Chętnie Ci pomożemy.
 Dowiedz się więcej, oglądając film Wprowadzenie do bezpieczeństwa i zgodności produktów z wymogami w Seller University.
 W razie dodatkowych pytań prześlij zgłoszenie w panelu Kondycja konta .

 CSBA Insights Dashboard
 Get the most out of Customer Service by Amazon
 Use the CSBA Insights dashboard in Seller Central to:
- Review customer service contacts handled by Amazon
- Find ways to improve customer experience
- Reduce contact and return rates
 Follow these practices to prevent customer confusion and minimize your workload:
- Monitor the Response Needed inbox within the Buyer-Seller Messaging Service . In the rare case that we need your help to resolve a customer issue, we'll summarize the conversation and pass the contact to you. You're expected to answer within 24 hours to ensure a great customer experience. You’ll still be responsible for pre-order inquiries.
- Avoid initiating 1:1 contact with customers. If you reach out to customers directly, Amazon can no longer support the customer regarding that order and you'll have to take responsibility for the rest of the conversation.
- Provide valid tracking. Include a valid tracking number with every shipment. This is the best way to prevent customers from contacting customer service.
- Improve product descriptions based on refunds. More accurate product descriptions can help manage customer expectations.
- Was a customer issued a refund incorrectly? If Amazon issues a refund and you don't think that you should be held financially responsible, do not contact the customer. Instead, file a claim for reimbursement via Seller Assurance for E-Commerce Transactions (SAFE-T). Learn more about SAFE-T claim eligibility and filing processes .
 CSBA Insights Dashboard
 How are CSBA fees calculated and applied?
 Fees are applied automatically to every shipped unit that is fulfilled by the merchant throughout Q3-2026. To learn more about program fees, go to
 Customer Service by Amazon fees .
- CSBA fees are not applied to any FBA, Easy Ship, or seller-fulfilled Prime units
- CPU rate is only calculated based on post-order contacts that Amazon handles on your behalf
- In rare instances, the contact count used for fee calculations may be lower than the total count shown on your dashboard. The difference in contacts counts does not impact your fees.
 For additional guidance, go to the
 CSBA help page .

Early access: Bring the trust of Prime to your ecommerce site with MCF
Hi there,
As an existing Multichannel Fulfillment (MCF) customer, you now have early access to MCF with Prime, a new feature that lets you offer Fast, Free Delivery for Prime members on your ecommerce site. Display the Prime badge on eligible product pages to build shopper confidence with the trust of Prime while maintaining your existing checkout experience. Shoppers don't even need to sign in to their Amazon account to receive Prime delivery.
This feature is currently available to you at no additional cost beyond your existing MCF fulfillment, storage, and surcharge rates.
Get started now https://www2.amazonsupplychain.com/e/949422/t-top-cta-utm-term-get-started/61pb2m/1432406019/h/fP8T0oPNUrdJZOMcQM4ricL3oCRc16K6DoVRFQfB7fE
With MCF with Prime, you can:
 - Leverage the trust of Prime: 40% of Prime members indicated that they are more likely to place a first-time purchase with a direct-to-consumer (DTC) store that features the Amazon Prime logo.*
 - Offer Fast, Free Delivery for Prime members: Deliver eligible orders through Amazon's fulfillment network.
 - Encourage repeat purchases: Strengthen customer loyalty with the trust of Prime. 50% of US Prime members indicated that they are more likely to buy again from DTC sites that offer Prime shopping benefits.*
To get started, follow the setup instructions for the MCF and Buy with Prime app for Shopify, WebBee, or Fulfil.io.
Please note that if you're currently using the Amazon MCF: US Fulfillment app for Shopify, you'll need to upgrade to the MCF and Buy with Prime app for Shopify to access this feature. https://www2.amazonsupplychain.com/e/949422/buy-with-prime/61pb2q/1432406019/h/fP8T0oPNUrdJZOMcQM4ricL3oCRc16K6DoVRFQfB7fE
Visit the user guide for upgrade instructions. https://www2.amazonsupplychain.com/e/949422/all-utm-content-txt-user-guide/61pb2t/1432406019/h/fP8T0oPNUrdJZOMcQM4ricL3oCRc16K6DoVRFQfB7fE
Get started now https://www2.amazonsupplychain.com/e/949422/t-btm-cta-utm-term-get-started/61pb2x/1432406019/h/fP8T0oPNUrdJZOMcQM4ricL3oCRc16K6DoVRFQfB7fE
Thank you,
The Multichannel Fulfillment team
